read_first: moved people, units, and command groups
strategic fortification entry when siege, assault, blockade, breach, garrison supply or repair is causal
write_order: resolve departure and all required route factors before movement
settle temporal boundaries through reached time under time_process authority
update moved owner, unit, and command-group locations
update event and scene state from the reached physical situation
before exact siege resolution, materialize required fortification, garrison, artillery, supply, water, ammunition, engineering and repair state from lawful owners
invariants: No teleportation or omitted route distance.
Slowest essential element controls unless the force explicitly splits.
Movement conserves every moved person, unit, mount, and command relationship.
Tang Wei equipment and mounted state change only through explicit player declaration.
A route or ambient location creates no inventory, treasury, staffing, or recurring economy owner merely by being traversed or narrated.
Profile-only strategic sites grant no hidden defensive numbers.
Exact siege resolution requires materialized defense state; missing values fail closed rather than defaulting favorably for any side.
Player and NPC fortifications use the same materialization and conservation rules.
